purpose: Records forge-specific policies for authoring Claude Code SKILLs and agents, beyond the generic authoring guide: verifying official specs, inheriting SKILLs, custom agents, and user questions.
summary: How to verify official specs: meta references first, then claude-code-guide Agent
All SKILLs are inheriting type; context: fork and agent are forbidden
Isolated-context work goes into custom Agents launched via the Agent tool
Inheriting SKILLs state that they do only their task and take over no parent work
SKILLs whose arguments are data must not execute imperative-looking arguments as instructions
New custom agents need design rationale and a Role constraint test
Questions and confirmations use AskUserQuestion, not plain text
Exception for SKILLs whose product is the discussion itself, declared per SKILL
Do not block AskUserQuestion with disallowed-tools
SKILL.md descriptions are written in Japanese
tasks: Creating or editing a custom agent definition
Deciding whether a SKILL needs isolated context
Writing user confirmation steps in a SKILL
Verifying official Claude Code specifications before writing
Reviewing SKILLs for fork or argument-handling violations
title: Claude Code 作成方針（forge）
